title: Sign in and reach the dashboard
description: A user can authenticate with valid credentials and land in the authenticated area with the dashboard displayed.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username or email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Verify the authenticated area is displayed
Verify the dashboard is displayed

title: Block unauthenticated access to protected routes
description: A user without a session is redirected or blocked from protected pages and sent to the login page.

steps.description: Navigate to /dashboard
Verify access is blocked
Verify the login page is displayed
Navigate to /projects
Verify access is blocked
Verify the login page is displayed
Navigate to /dispatch
Verify access is blocked
Verify the login page is displayed
Navigate to /users
Verify access is blocked
Verify the login page is displayed

title: Edit a dispatch record and keep the changes visible
description: An authenticated user can update a dispatch record and see the updated dispatch information afterward.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username or email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the link to access dispatch
Open a dispatch record for editing
Change an editable dispatch field to a valid new value
Save the dispatch changes
Verify the updated dispatch information is displayed

title: View dashboard metrics after signing in
